lines.text: God's promise gives the psalmist comfort in affliction, and he finds comfort remembering the LORD's judgments of old.
Rage takes hold of him because the wicked reject God's law, and God's statutes are songs to him.
He promised to keep God's words, hurried without hesitating to obey, and rises at dawn to give thanks.
He is a friend to all who fear God, and before he was afflicted he went astray.
Affliction was good for him to learn God's statutes, and the law is more precious than thousands of rams.
